description: This file defines classes and functions for handling HTTP requests within the Playwright testing framework, including request execution, response handling, cookie management, redirects, and request context management.

classes.name: APIRequestContext
classes.description: Abstract class managing HTTP request execution, response storage, and event emission within a request context.

classes.name: BrowserContextAPIRequestContext
classes.description: Implementation of APIRequestContext tied to a specific browser context, managing cookies and storage state.

classes.name: GlobalAPIRequestContext
classes.description: Global implementation of APIRequestContext, managing cookies, options, and tracing for the entire Playwright environment.

classes.name: SafeEmptyStreamTransform
classes.description: Transform stream that handles empty streams during decompression to prevent errors.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with retries, handles redirects, cookies, and decompression, and returns the response.

methods.name: _sendRequest
methods.description: Internal method to send an HTTP request, handle response, and manage request lifecycle.

methods.name: _sendRequestWithRetries
methods.description: Retries the request on connection resets according to maxRetries.

methods.name: _updateRequestCookieHeader
methods.description: Updates the Cookie header with cookies from the context before sending the request.

methods.name: _getHttpCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP credentials for a given URL if applicable.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the request context, clearing stored responses and logs.

methods.name: tracing
methods.description: Returns the tracing object associated with the request context.

methods.name: _defaultOptions
methods.description: Returns default fetch options for the context.

methods.name: _cookies
methods.description: Retrieves cookies for a given URL.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Returns the storage state including cookies and origins.
